Exploratory Data Analysis¶

Predictive Valuation Modeling for Detecting Price Anomalies in Bengaluru Residential Resale Apartments¶

Objective¶

This notebook performs exploratory data analysis on the collected Bengaluru residential resale apartment dataset.

The analysis focuses on understanding:

  • Distribution of apartment listing prices
  • Property size and configuration
  • Relationship between property characteristics and price
  • Location-wise price differences
  • Missing values and data quality
  • Relationships among numerical variables
  • Differences between real and synthetically generated records

The target variable for the predictive modeling stage is listing price.
